title: How should new conveying equipment connect to an existing forged-ball line during a partial retrofit?
summary: A group of forged-ball line retrofit documents covers bar discharge, air cooling before and after ball tempering, a tempering furnace and bagging equipment. Individual equipment operation must be followed by confirmation of old control programmes, station elevations, residence times and bagging handovers.
